title: Green's essay on electricity and magnetism
summary: Self-taught miller George Green published An Essay on the Application of Mathematical Analysis to the Theories of Electricity and Magnetism, introducing tools now called Green's theorem and Green's functions.
why: His methods are used throughout physics and engineering.

unsung.contribution: Created mathematical methods for electricity and magnetism now known as Green's theorem and Green's functions.
unsung.recognition: He received little recognition in his lifetime; William Thomson (Lord Kelvin) rediscovered the Essay after his death.
